notes: License verified verbatim at raw.githubusercontent.com/google-research-datasets/scin/main/LICENSE on 2026-08-18: zero occurrences of 'commercial'/'non-commercial'/'research only'. Sec 1(f) defines Licensed Material as 'the images, labeling and other data', so images and annotations are cleared by the SAME grant. Sec 2(a)(1) grants a 'worldwide, royalty-free, non-sublicensable, non-exclusive, irrevocable' right to reproduce/Share and to produce Adapted Material. CONDITIONS: (1) Sec 3(b) no re-identification or re-linking of data subjects, breach terminates all rights automatically; (2) Sec 3(a)(1) attribution+copyright notice+license reference+URI and a modification indication, triggered only when You Share; (3) Sec 2(a)(5)(b) no downstream restrictions on Licensed/Adapted Material; (4) Sec 6(a) auto-termination on any non-compliance, 30-day cure. LEGAL REVIEW FLAGS: Sec 2(b)(1) does NOT license publicity, privacy or personality rights of the depicted contributors, which is the live risk for a commercial product using identifiable people; README states the dataset 'is intended for health education and research', which is intent language and not a field-of-use limit in the license, but the mismatch should be confirmed by counsel. NOT FIT FOR CALIBRATION (verified against dataset_schema.md): labels are dermatologist condition NAMES with a diagnostic confidence 1-5, which is confidence and NOT severity; there is no severity, redness, texture, wrinkle or pigmentation grade anywhere in the schema; granularity is case-level with up to 3 images, not per-image and not per-ROI; the only location field is a user-reported body_parts_HEAD_OR_NECK boolean, which cannot resolve forehead/cheek/under-eye/nasolabial/chin/crows-feet/nose. POPULATION MISMATCH (JAMA Netw Open 2024;7(11):e2446615, doi 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2024.46615): disease-selected cohort recruited via dermatology search ads, 89.0% of assignable cases allergic/infectious/inflammatory and 54.0% with onset under 7 days, so its median/MAD would encode inflamed pathological skin as the population baseline and desensitise the redness scale; contributors skew female 66.7% and under-40 52.0% vs US census; capture is uncontrolled mobile with shot_type CLOSE_UP/AT_AN_ANGLE/AT_DISTANCE and no fixed distance, lighting or white balance, which D4/D5 make load-bearing for the colour copy. This is not legal advice.
